hypotheses.justification: mapN and mapN_eq_iff require no nonzero assumption. Split on P = 0. In that case Nat.coprime_zero_left gives M₁ = 1; choose g₁ = g. The first equality is reflexive, and the second follows from mapN_eq_iff since 1 divides every integer. Otherwise install NeZero P and use the existing proof. Both nonzero hypotheses can also be removed simultaneously.

Split on M₁ = 0. Nat.coprime_zero_right then gives P = 1; choose g₁ = 1. The second equality follows because mapN is a monoid homomorphism, and the first follows from mapN_eq_iff since 1 divides every integer. Otherwise install NeZero M₁ and use the existing proof. Neither mapN nor the conclusion requires this instance; both nonzero hypotheses can also be removed simultaneously.
